draft.goal: Implement and measure bounded real-WIC decode admission for 2K/4K materialization and 8K/16K refusal, including high-compression inputs and ROI non-bypass, without claiming full 16K decode or internal decoder allocation bounds.

tasks.goal: Implement and measure the W7 large-dimension admission/materialization matrix under DC-MP-IMG2 without changing product decode policy.

inputs.description: Full caller-selected W7 directive: docs/development/evidence-published/img2-w6-latest/tern-next-directive.txt (verbatim, 1205 lines) with two-read correlation in tern-next-directive.json. All constraints and acceptance below are caller-authored projections of it.

MP-IMG1 and MP-SEC3 technical completion; MP ss19.55-.59; DC-MP-IMG2 and media input admission/integrity; BUILD_AND_RUN 4.23-4.26; TESTING; Rendering ss6/6.1/10; ADR-0009/0012. W6 limited completion does not satisfy MP-IMG3.

Reuse w2_resource_matrix.Worker with its closed stop state machine and ROI/budget/limit arguments, w2_resource_verify constants, w2_independent_oracle and w3/w4/w5/w6 fixture/oracle/verifier patterns, decode_compare harness and wic_probe.ps1 without editing the probe.

constraints.text: Use DC-MP-IMG2 only under ADR-0009/0012. Start daddc4ac82f2432e18e7545e1d37045240650e64 on dev. Preserve W1-W6 source, native, Gate and review bytes; no push, main or release.

Do not change crates/media DecodeLimits/DecodeRequest/admit_decode authority, W1 full-frame budget, W2 trace/stop contract, W3 Bgr565 admission, W4 ROI output semantics, W5 metadata classification, W6 memory scope, legacy CLI contract, GPUI, Runtime, dependencies or unsafe/FFI.

Six deterministic non-uniform 2K/4K fixtures (PNG RGB8, BMP24, real Bgr565 BI_BITFIELDS at 2048 and 4096), two refusal PNGs at 8192 and 16384, and four derived negative inputs (1x1 ROI requests on both refusal sizes, dimension-tampered and truncated 16384 PNG). Twelve cases total, single worker, encoded input at most 64 MiB per case.

W7 experimental limits only: max dimension 4096, max pixels 16777216, max decoded 67108864, max scratch 67108864 with zero declared scratch, output 96 MiB, work root 512 MiB, report 8 MiB, trace 128 records/128 KiB, 64 KiB per capture, 45 s per worker, 300 s global, observed private ceiling 768 MiB. Never enlarge a limit to manufacture success.

Admission is the safety boundary: 8K/16K are refused before OnLoad by full-frame dimension/pixels with no output and no published success; a 1x1 ROI never reduces the full-frame requirement. Encoded size is never treated as decoded allocation.

Keep HEADER_READ, ADMITTED, REFUSED, DECODED, TIMEOUT, CANCELLED, NOT_VERIFIED and NOT_RUN distinct. Refusals record UNAVAILABLE fallback and NOT_PROVEN preview. Unobservable counters stay NOT_MEASURED, never zero.

Expected pixels come from independent PNG/BMP/Bgr565 parsing with streaming row comparison, never from WIC output; record input, expected RGBA, actual RGBA digests, compared pixels and first mismatch.
Preserve the W2 confirmed-stop contract; a killed OnLoad worker is not cooperative cancellation, and artificial hold time is not decoder latency. Recover only owned processes.
Ship a fail-closed verifier and exercise at least the 24 required mutation classes through verify(); structural-only replay must report source_identity_verified=false and closure_eligible=false.

Stop and record DESIGN_BLOCKED, AUTHORITY_BLOCKED, SAFETY_BLOCKED, NOT_RUN, NOT_MEASURED or NOT_VERIFIED instead of inventing an unapproved design; 4K runs only after pre-checking encoded, decoded, scratch and disk headroom.

outputs.description: Deterministic W6 fixtures, repeated process sampler/matrix, independent fail-closed verifier and focused tests.
Bounded Windows matrix, raw sample series, source/executable identities, cohort comparisons, arithmetic, independent raster proof and explicit measurement limitations.
Local quality and historical regression outcomes; pinned same-candidate Quality/Build receipts, artifact bytes, retention, complete Tern review and limited disposition.

acceptance.statement: New W7 SOURCE and Taskern packet are fixed before Native execution.
Six 2K/4K fixtures regenerate byte-identically and the large inputs' encoded geometry is independently verified.
Real Windows 2K/4K WIC decodes materialize and every decoded output matches the independent RGBA oracle.
8K and 16K inputs are refused at full-frame admission before OnLoad with no output or published success.
1x1 ROI requests on 8K/16K are refused by the same full-frame budget, proving no ROI bypass.
High-compression inputs still declare the full decoded requirement; encoded size is never used as the budget.
Process identity, lifetime and memory counters are observed and separated from internal scratch and true allocation peaks.
All required negative mutation classes are rejected by the real verifier.
W1-W6 historical regressions and current-source compatibility checks pass without rewriting historical records.
A new independent Quality Gate and Build Gate succeed on the same pinned candidate with byte-identical artifact correspondence.
The complete Tern review of the fixed candidate returns 0/0/0 with two-read correlation.

W7 limited completion is recorded while 16K full decode, partial/sequential/tiled, internal scratch, reservations, concurrent peak, cooperative cancellation, ICC, Decode Exit, IMG3, Runtime and UX stay unmeasured.

evaluation.requirement: Actual bounded Windows WIC execution plus independent source-raster, arithmetic, admission, identity and mutation verification that preserves every missing or failing fact.
Actual Taskern prepare, unchanged local/feature/R0/historical checks, new same-candidate Refine Quality/Build with native integrity, privacy-reviewed Tern packages and complete 0/0/0.
